featured_reviews.review_text:
Genuine hard work in one's job or business is more manifest than one's spoken words; it is like surrendering to one's work. I have experienced this in the quality results of different people's activities. One such experience was at Navin Surekha Photo Studio in Vile Parle East, very near the railway station. I had to convert my 41-year-old VHS video cassette to digital format. I was not sure that it would be converted to digital, but when I met Mr. Ojas bhai, the owner of the said photo studio, he assured me of a good result. And after two weeks of eager anticipation, I got surprisingly good results. Previously, 20-30 years ago i had converted this video cassette to CD quality from another shop, but its quality was not satisfactory to me. Thank God! My good luck was waiting for me to give a blissful experience from this result.
Though some old, unclean, fungus-damaged video scenes were not at a satisfactory level, most of the video results were very good compared to 40-year-old recordings and better than CD quality. So, thanks to Navin Surekha Studio, especially to Mr. Ojas, who gave me assured results. A very polite and good knowledgeable person. Thanks again!!🙏🏻

featured_reviews.name: Shail Bharadwaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
We usually don’t opt for photoshoots, but we decided to book one to capture some special moments with our newborn. Unfortunately, our experience was quite disappointing.

To begin with, the overall setup did not meet basic expectations. Our newborn was placed on the floor with only a thin cloth, and we had to provide our own clean blankets to ensure comfort and hygiene. The fabric used for wrapping the baby also appeared worn and not well-maintained. Additionally, there was no coordinator present at the shoot location, which made the process feel unorganized.

We were hopeful that the final photos would make up for the experience, but that was not the case. The editing seemed overly artificial, with what appeared to be AI-generated enhancements, including an unnatural smile added to our baby’s photos. The photography itself also lacked attention to angles and detail.

When we raised our concerns, the response we received was dismissive, suggesting that we review the photos more carefully rather than addressing the issues.

Overall, this felt like a poor use of money and a missed opportunity to capture meaningful moments. We genuinely feel that even our own phone photos would have turned out better. Based on our experience, we would not recommend this service.
